title: Anthony Hudson (Michigan)
intro: Anthony Hudson (Libertarian Party) is running for election for Governor of Michigan. He is on the ballot on a joint ticket with Beau Parmenter in the general election on November 3, 2026. He advanced from the Libertarian Party convention on June 28, 2026.
